SP3DHX7ZHNTCE1WQHJH0T0HY9NNSVT4SWTY2FRCC.note: Deliberately not renamed. This contract is registered with signer key 0x038cb1e945…, the same key as .signer-manager-stackslabs-3, and slotwatch.dev names that key L2-Labs-3. But the name belongs to whoever runs the signer, not to every contract pointing at it, so calling this pool L2-Labs-3 would be a claim nobody made. 'Hiro' is what the contract id says and it stays a reading of the contract id until someone confirms the pool.

Deliberately not renamed. slotwatch.dev names this signer key 'Blockdaemon*' — same operator the contract id already says, and the asterisk is a marker of theirs whose meaning is not documented anywhere we can find. Dropping it would be inventing a name, keeping it would be copying another site's footnote, and 'Blockdaemon' alone loses the V1 that tells this apart from the rest of the -v1 family under this principal. Nothing to add, so nothing is claimed.
